He has San Francisco at 4-0 and continues to give fantasy managers a solid floor as a low-end QB1 in one of the NFL's better offenses. Purdy will face the Seattle Seahawks in Week 5.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 23 of 41 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Bryce Young throws one touchdown, one pick in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Young put up a so-so performance overall in Green Bay on Thursday night. Considering he was absolutely harassed by the Packers' pass rush, going down for six sacks, his output could've, and probably should've, been much worse. Still, since a strong start to the season, it's been a tough couple of weeks for Young in back-to-back losses. Things won't get any easier against the Broncos' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 14-of-27 passes for 163 yards with a touchdown and two picks and a fumble in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Bucs on Sunday. He also ran once for nine yards.
news.head: Bryce Young struggles in loss to Bucs
news.impact: Young had his worst game of the season in this one, with his top two receivers, Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, held to just five catches for 49 yards combined. He better shake off this loss quickly, as the Panthers face off against the Packers on Thursday night.

news.body: Carolina Panthers quarterback Bryce Young completed 20 of 39 passes for 281 yards and two touchdowns against the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 6.
news.head: Bryce Young tosses pair of scores in Week 6 win
news.impact: Young delivered against a talented Philly defense with his fourth multi-touchdown game in five weeks. He has two scores and no turnovers in each of the last two games, emerging from the Week 5 bye with the same flair. Young has at least 280 passing yards in every game, giving him an impressive floor at quarterback.

news.body: Bryce Young (knee) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Bryce Young (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was previously managing a knee issue, but he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday, so it seems to be a non-issue for him as the team comes off of their bye week. He should play in Week 6 and will look to continue to build on his momentum against a tough Eagles' defense.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 24-of-34 passing attempts for 247 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Caleb Williams scores once in big win Monday
news.impact: Williams played very well on Monday night, but since most of Chicago's touchdowns came on the ground, that didn't come through on the stat sheet very strongly. Still, fantasy managers should be ecstatic with how this Chicago looks at this point in the season and should expect Williams to be a strong starter over the back half of the year.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 22 of 33 passes for 308 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Caleb Williams throws for more than 300 yards in Week 7 win
news.impact: Williams added 18 yards on five carries to his strong stat line from Thursday night. The third-year pro has been excellent since returning from injury, leading the Bears to two victories over the past five days. Williams has cleared 300 yards in each of those games, tossing three touchdowns without an interception.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 pass attempts for 305 yards and one touchdown while also rushing four times for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Caleb Williams efficient in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Williams was impactful in his return to the lineup for head coach Ben Johnson, surpassing 300 passing yards for the first time in his three contests while battling a hamstring injury. The dual-threat signal-caller remains a dynamic lineup option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is the starter for the Bears on Sunday against the Falcons. After a few weeks' absence, the franchise QB is back.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) starting for the Bears Sunday
news.impact: Williams was initially questionable to play, but the Bears are now planning on getting him back in the lineup after a week of practice where he took starter reps. It will be interesting to see Caleb in a more "regular" game and how it affects the pass catchers, who have only played with Caleb in one normal game, and even that "normal" game saw copious amounts of production from the running backs.

news.body: Carson Wentz will start Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Carson Wentz will start in Week 9 for Vikings
news.impact: Kyler Murray is continuing to battle a sore hamstring. Wentz will be a QB2 for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.

news.body: Carson Wentz is reportedly trending towards starting in Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Carson Wentz trending towards starting in Week 9
news.impact: Kyler Murray is continuing to be evaluated for his hamstring injury. “His status for Monday night is, at best, up in the air, and it sounds like it is trending toward Carson Wentz starting on Monday night,” Adam Schefter said.

news.body: Carson Wentz completed 11-of-20 pass attempts for 143 yards while also rushing three times for six yards in the Vikings' 9-3 Week 2 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Carson Wentz quiet in Week 2 win over Bears
news.impact: Wentz has struggled to make an impact behind center to begin the season, finishing with less than 145 passing yards in each of the first two games. The quarterback could be relegated to the bench if No. 1 signal-caller Kyler Murray (concussion) is able to suit up for a Week 3 contest against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

news.body: Carson Wentz is set to be Minnesota's starting quarterback in their matchup against the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
news.head: Carson Wentz set to start for Week 2
news.impact: The Vikings have ruled out Kyler Murray (concussion) ahead of Sunday's game and announced that Wentz would be the starter in his absence. That's good news for the fantasy outlook of Justin Jefferson and Aaron Jones Sr. this week, as Minnesota's offense has been able to produce ample fantasy points in the few occasions that Wentz has been at the helm for the team.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 17-of-28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud did not throw for many yards, but he also didn't commit any turnovers. The Texans are heading into their bye next week.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 24-of-34 pass attempts for 312 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Jaguars. He rushed for five yards on his lone rushing attempt.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
news.impact: Stroud found 10 different pass catchers as he spread the ball around effectively and kept the Jaguars' defense guessing. Stroud has eclipsed 300 yards passing in three games this season and set a new season high with three touchdown passes. Houston will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 26-of-34 passes for 261 yards and one touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: C.J. Stroud totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud also added a rushing score at the goal line. He was able to take care of the ball in a game where the Texans defense dominated. He'll be a QB2 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-31 passes for 347 yards with two touchdowns in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: C.J. Stroud throws for 347 yards Sunday
news.impact: Stroud was at his best on Sunday with the return of Nico Collins. He gave the team the lead in the final minutes before the defense wound up blowing it to move to 0-4 on the season. He'll be a QB2 play against the Titans next week.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 20 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
news.head: Dak Prescott records two touchdowns in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Prescott was unable to find consistent success Sunday, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a leaky Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 212 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Dak Prescott tosses three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Prescott had a pretty nice showing on Monday night. He totaled over 200 yards on the night and was able to score three touchdowns while leading the Cowboys to a comfortable win over Philadelphia. He will continue to be a good depth piece or streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 34 of his 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding two rushes for seven yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Prescott and the Cowboys were shut out by the Packers in the first half before showing some life after halftime. The veteran's lone TD pass went to Ryan Flournoy with 44 seconds left in the contest. Prescott survived an injury scare in the first half as he took a huge hit after a pass attempt and appeared to be favoring his ribs. He ultimately didn't miss any time in the game, but it is something worth monitoring this week. Prescott has now thrown for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games this season. He will be a low-end QB1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards and a touchdown with two picks in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws for 316 yards in loss
news.impact: It was not Dak's best showing, struggling against a secondary that had been picked on up to this point in the season. He will look to right the ship against the Packers on Sunday Night Football a little over a week from now.

news.body: Daniel Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback in Week 9 against the Cowboys.
news.head: Daniel Jones struggles in Week 8, to remain starter
news.impact: Jones completed 19 of 28 passes for just 144 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions before exiting Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars. The veteran QB was replaced late in the game by backup Anthony Richardson, but Jones will move forward as the starter for head coach Shane Steichen, at least for one more week.

news.body: Daniel Jones is still the Colts starter, per HC Shane Steichen.
news.head: Daniel Jones backed by HC Steichen, still Colts starter
news.impact: Jones has been downright abysmal this season, throwing just four touchdown passes to seven interceptions, with only one passing touchdown in the last four games. His rushing hasn’t been there for him either, as he’s only had one score on the ground and is averaging fewer than 10 rushing yards per game this season. Rumblings will build for the team to give Anthony Richardson or some other name a shot if things continue to spiral, Steichen is likely coaching for his job, and Jones is playing for his job at this point as well. He’s the QB28 on the season, but the QB37 in PPG among QBs with multiple games under their belt. He’s not startable in any league at this point.

news.body: Daniel Jones completed 13-of-22 passes for 108 yards and an interception in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Daniel Jones shut down Sunday
news.impact: Jones was already struggling heading into this week and it didn't get any easier against the Vikings defense. He took four sacks and didn't get much going on the ground. He'll be a QB2 heading into next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Colts head coach Shane Steichen confirmed that Daniel Jones will start in Week 7 against the Vikings.
news.head: Daniel Jones will start in Week 7
news.impact: Jones struggles continued in Sunday's loss against the Titans. He'll be a low-end QB2 play in Week 7 against the Vikings defense.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 16-of-20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns, also running eight times for five yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Drake Maye puts up three touchdowns in win over Miami
news.impact: Maye struggled mightily in the first half, but turned things around in the second half on his way to three touchdowns, two through the air, one on the ground. It wasn't all pretty, but he made it work for fantasy managers, who are riding high on his hot streak.

news.body: Drake Maye was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Maye will be a QB1 play this week for fantasy managers against the Dolphins.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception, adding 26 yards and another touchdown on four carries during Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Drake Maye accounts for three touchdowns in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Patriots certainly wanted the win, but fantasy managers enjoyed a big performance from Maye. The third-year QB threw for more than 300 yards for the second time in the last three weeks, and he's now scored 11 total touchdowns during that span. Maye will be a certain start at Miami in Week 8.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 18-of-32 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a 26-19 win over the Jets. Maye added 24 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
news.impact: Maye found DeMario Douglas, Hunter Henry, and Romeo Doubs for his three touchdown passes. Maye turned another spotless performance, logging two straight games without a turnover after throwing seven interceptions in the first four games. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

news.body: Drew Lock (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Drew Lock (elbow) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Lock's elbow injury is nothing serious and he is good to go for Sunday's game against Arizona. He is set to be the team's starting quarterback with Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) ruled out, so Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects to be the only viable pass catcher for the Seahawks this week.

news.body: Drew Lock remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Drew Lock (elbow) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Lock remains on track to start Sunday's game against the Cardinals for the Seahawks after being unavailable the past couple of weeks.

news.body: Drew Lock (elbow) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Drew Lock (elbow) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Lock wasn't able to log a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday. He was limited due to an elbow injury that he's dealing with, which is less than ideal given that he is set to start in place of Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) this week. This is a situation worth keeping tabs on throughout the rest of the week.

news.body: The Seahawks will start Drew Lock on Sunday against the Cardinals following a quad injury for Sam Darnold.
news.head: Drew Lock to start for Seahawks in Week 9
news.impact: Darnold suffered a quad injury in Monday's loss against the Bears. Lock will be getting his second start against Arizona this season.

news.body: Geno Smith completed 20-of-32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 38-33 loss to the Jets. He added four rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Geno Smith tosses late interception in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Smith found Adonai Mitchell and Isaiah Williams in the second quarter to account for his two touchdown passes. Smith has struggled with the turnovers as of late, tossing an interception in three straight games. Smith and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Geno Smith completed 23-of-30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in a 28-25 loss to Miami.
news.head: Geno Smith tosses three touchdowns in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Smith and the Jets trailed the Dolphins, allowing for a high volume passing attack in the final three quarters. Smith connected with Mason Taylor twice and Omar Cooper for his three touchdown passes. Smith and the Jets will take on the Raiders in Week 8.

news.body: Geno Smith completed 20-of-30 pass attempts for 252 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Geno Smith tosses one touchdown in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Smith connected with Omar Cooper Jr. on a deep pass for the Jets' lone passing touchdown of the day. Smith spread the ball around effectively and was intercepted for the first time this season. The Jets and Smith will take on Miami at home in Week 7.

news.body: Geno Smith completed 17 of his 30 passes for 182 yards and one touchdown while adding seven yards on five carries in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Geno Smith throws TD in Week 5 win
news.impact: Smith struggled in rainy conditions at home in MetLife Stadium but he was still able to lead his team to the win. He lost a fumble on a strip-sack in the fourth quarter while his lone touchdown pass went to Garrett Wilson on a 32-yard connection in the first quarter. Smith has now thrown for six touchdowns and zero interceptions through five games. He will be on the QB2 radar in Week 6's road matchup against the Patriots.

news.body: The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a trade to send QB Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett traded to Ravens
news.impact: The deal is expected to be finalized this weekend. The Ravens get their new starting quarterback after losing Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injuries.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett has officially been benched by the Cardinals.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett officially benched by Cardinals
news.impact: Gardner Minshew II was named the starter after leading Arizona to a comeback win on Sunday against the Cowboys. Minshew will start in Week 9 in Seattle.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett has been benched by the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Darren Urban.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett benched Sunday
news.impact: Brissett was taken out after completing 10-of-23 pass attempts for 119 yards and one interception. Backup Gardner Minshew has taken over behind center against the Cowboys Sunday.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 27 of 48 passes for 272 yards and one touchdown, while rushing seven times for 16 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett Throws for 272 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Brissett attempted 48 passes with Arizona playing from behind, but averaged just 5.7 yards per attempt. His lone touchdown went to Trey McBride, and he avoided turning the ball over against one of the NFL's better defenses. The volume, though, gives Brissett some streaming value, but he's better viewed as a QB2.

news.body: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) is out for the remainder of the 2026 NFL Season due to blood clots found in his lungs. Hurts was on blood thinners already to treat the clot that was originally found, but will need additional treatment to bring him back to full health. He is expected to make a full recovery.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) out for the season as additional clots are found
news.impact: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB. This is obviously extremely serious news for Hurts, his family, and the team, so don’t lose sight of that, but it’s relieving to hear he should make a full recovery. As for football, it’s a big blow for an already struggling Eagles team, who will now proceed with Tanner McKee at QB. Don’t be surprised if Cole Payton also sees some run towards the end of the year if things really fly south for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR
news.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.

news.body: Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts ruled out Sunday due to superficial blood clot
news.impact: Per the Eagles, Hurts underwent an ultrasound that revealed a superficial blood clot. "On Wednesday night, a follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in the small blood clot." It will likely be Tanner McKee starting for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hurts fantasy value will largely be dependant on the health of DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley. He is a risky start for fantasy managers as of now given his recent struggles.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 18-of-25 pass attempts for 176 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jared Goff held in check in Week 8 win
news.impact: Goff was mostly held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track in a favorable matchup against the Miami Dolphins in Week 9.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 22-of-32 passing attempts for 303 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jared Goff plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran quarterback played pretty well on Sunday, racking up over 300 yards and scoring twice while leading the Lions to a win over their divisional rival. His lost fumble was less than ideal, but fantasy managers should still be well pleased with his performance in this game.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 19-of-30 passing attempts for 271 yards and three touchdowns and added another in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jared Goff scores four touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Goff was able to lead the Lions to an easy win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He was very efficient over the course of the afternoon, racking up nearly 300 total yards and four touchdowns, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. He projects to be a quality fantasy option again in a home matchup against the Packers next week.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 32 of 52 passes for 412 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Jared Goff airs it out for 412 yards in Sunday night's loss
news.impact: Through Sunday, Goff now holds the NFL's highest single-game total in passing yards for the season. The Lions threw the ball 52 times compared to just 15 runs, leading to Goff's seventh career 400-yard passing performance. Surprisingly, the Lions' QB only connected for one touchdown pass on the night. Overall, Goff has been excellent through four weeks, completing 67.7% of his throws for better than 300 yards per game with a 9-0 TD/INT ratio.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 16 of his 29 passes for 217 yards and one touchdown while adding 23 yards on two rushes in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws one TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Daniels didn't post huge numbers in the Sunday night win but it didn't matter against a sputtering Philadelphia team. His lone touchdown pass went to Stefon Diggs on an eight-yard completion in the second quarter. Daniels has thrown for 976 yards, six touchdowns, and zero interceptions in five contests this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 29 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns while adding four rushes for 10 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws for 300 yards, two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Unlike Week 5, Daniels didn't do much damage on the ground, but he made up for it with a solid day in the passing attack. His touchdown passes both came in the second half with one going to Stefon Diggs and the other to Rachaad White. Daniels has thrown for 759 yards and five touchdowns across four games this season. A solid QB1 in fantasy going forward, he will be on bye in Week 7 before taking on the Eagles in Week 8.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 199 yards while also carrying the ball nine times for a team-high 103 yards and two touchdowns in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
news.head: Jayden Daniels dynamic on ground in Week 5 tie with Giants
news.impact: Daniels carried an otherwise underwhelming Washington offense in his return to the lineup, recording two touchdowns for the second time in his three games. The quarterback remains an electric dual-threat option behind center ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers for head coach Dan Quinn.

news.body: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports that Jayden Daniels is not "100 percent” healthy yet.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) still not '100 percent' healthy
news.impact: Daniels is still slated to play on Sunday against the Giants, but re-injury risk is a bit of a concern.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy completed 20-of-28 passes for 252 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy impresses through air Sunday
news.impact: Making his first start for the Giants, McCarthy did not throw a touchdown or turn the ball over. He was able to find Malik Nabers early and often. He'll be a QB2 in superflex and 2-QB leagues moving forward.

news.body: Giants OC Matt Nagy said J.J. McCarthy will have 100 percent of the play book to work with.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy to have 100 percent of playbook to work with
news.impact: McCarthy will get his first official start with the Giants. He'll be a QB2 play in a tough matchup against the Texans.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy will be the Giants starter in their Week 7 matchup against Houston.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy starting for Giants in Week 7
news.impact: The Giants have benched Jameis Winston in favor of the younger McCarthy, who came to the Giants via trade with Minnesota a couple weeks ago. McCarthy has his flaws, some of which were on full display in the Giants comeback attempt against the Saints. However, he also nearly brought them back to a win, so it sounds like the coaching staff has decided the benefits outweigh the risks. Expect Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely to continue to be force fed targets, with smaller shares going to Malachi Fields, Darnell Mooney, and the like.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy completed 11-of-21 passes for 243 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy throws for 243 yards Sunday
news.impact: McCarthy entered the game in the fourth quarter and took advantage of his opportunity. He threw an interception, but also almost helped lead them to a huge comeback. He connected with Isaiah Likely for a touchdown. It is unclear who will start next week.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 38 of his 48 passes for 462 yards, five touchdowns, and three interceptions while adding three rushes for 10 yards and a touchdown on the ground in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws five TDs, three INTs in Week 8 win
news.impact: Burrow turned in a huge game as the Titans surprisingly gave the Bengals all they could handle. The Cincy quarterback is heating up of late as he's thrown 13 touchdowns over his past three contests. Overall, Burrow has 20 touchdowns and six interceptions through seven games. He will be a high-end QB1 in Week 8 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 22-of-30 passes for 292 yards and four touchdowns in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 12 yards on two carries.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses four touchdowns in Week 7 win
news.impact: Burrow and the Bengals' offense came alive in the second half, erasing a 13-0 deficit with a 35 point performance to close out the comeback win. Burrow has eight touchdown passes in his last two games and will look to continue his recent strong play against the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 23-of-32 passing attempts for 190 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws four touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Burrow looked great on Sunday. He scored four touchdowns through the air en route to a win over the Dolphins, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. The Bengals are now heading into their bye week but he should continue to be a great fantasy option when the team is back out on the field.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 39-of-54 passing attempts for 428 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding six yards and a touchdown on the ground in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Burrow had an up-and-down performance on Sunday. On the one hand, he was able to throw for over 425 yards and logged two total touchdowns against the Jaguars. On the other hand, he threw two interceptions and led Cincinnati to score just 17 points in a loss at home. His fantasy value for next week will heavily depend on the health of Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) for their matchup against the Dolphins.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Jordan Love fires three TD passes in Thursday night win
news.impact: Aside from an early fourth-quarter pick deep into n Carolina territory, Love was pretty locked in on Thursday. The Panthers did not generate much of a pass rush, failing to sack Love even once, and that kept the Green Bay QB comfortable in the pocket most of the night. Love has thrown an interception in three straight games now, but he has countered that with six touchdown passes and an additional score on the ground. He's also averaged just under 280 passing yards per game in that span.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 27-of-45 passing attempts for 274 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Jordan Love throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Love had an okay game on Sunday. He threw for close to 300 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the game, but he also threw two interceptions and didn't have a very high completion percentage on the day. He will continue to be a viable week-to-week streaming option moving forward.

news.body: Jordan Love (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Jordan Love (back) without injury designation for Sunday
news.impact: Love was managing a minor back issue early on in the week, but to no surprise, he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He should be considered a solid streaming option this week in a favorable matchup against Detroit.

news.body: Jordan Love (back) was officially limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Love (back) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Love is now dealing with some kind of a back issue. It left him limited at practice on Wednesday, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for the veteran quarterback at this point. Fantasy managers should not be concerned about his availability unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 21-of-34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for three touchdowns in Week 8 win
news.impact: Allen opened the scoring with a one-yard rush in first quarter and found DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid on passing touchdowns to ice the game in the fourth quarter. Allen has at least two touchdowns in every game so far this season. He will look to continue to build on his strong start to the season against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passing attempts for 255 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Josh Allen scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Allen played a solid game on Sunday, racking up 255 yards and two touchdowns through the air while not turning the ball over at all. He had just one yard on the ground in this game, however, which is extremely uncommon for him, especially after he rushed for over 120 yards last week. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 12 of his 19 passes for 210 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 121 yards and a rushing touchdown on the ground in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Josh Allen rushes for 121 yards, TD in Week 5 win
news.impact: Allen didn't have his best passing game but he dominated the Rams on the ground in the thrilling Monday night win as he easily set a season-high in rushing yards. His lone touchdown pass went to Keon Coleman in the third quarter. Allen has thrown for 1,249 yards, seven touchdowns, and four interceptions through five games this season. He will remain a top-three fantasy quarterback heading into Week 6 against the Raiders.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passes for 254 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the loss to the Patriots. He rushed for four yards and a touchdown on five carries.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for two touchdowns in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Allen turned in a solid day Sunday, including a touchdown pass to Keon Coleman late in the game. Allen was without DJ Moore, who left the game in the first half with a shoulder injury. His interception late in the game ended up a comeback and handed the Bills their first loss of the season. Allen and the Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 19-of-26 passes for 247 yards and three touchdowns in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He rushed for three yards and a touchdown on five carries.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses three touchdowns in Week 8 win
news.impact: Cousins found Brock Bowers for two of his touchdown passes before finding Jalen Nailor on a two-yard touchdown pass to give the Raiders the lead in the fourth quarter. Cousins has logged four games of three passing touchdowns so far this season. Cousins and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 26-of-44 pass attempts for 295 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing three times for six yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses two touchdowns in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Cousins has been impactful behind center, tossing two or more touchdowns in six of seven contests. The veteran signal-caller will look to take advantage of an inconsistent New York Jets offense in Week 8.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 23-of-41 passing attempts for 313 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Kirk Cousins throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Cousins played a pretty good game on Sunday. His interception was a blemish, but besides that he threw for over 300 yards and two touchdowns in a narrow loss to the Bills. He has been playing quite well lately and will continue to be a worthwhile streaming option moving forward.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 19-of-28 passes for 243 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders loss to the Patriots Sunday.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses one touchdown in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Cousins completed his lone touchdown pass to Brock Bowers in the first quarter, and then the Raiders offense struggled to get anything going from there. Cousins and the Raiders will return home and take on the Bills in Week 6.

news.body: Kyler Murray is considered week-to-week with his hamstring injury.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) week-to-week
news.impact: Carson Wentz was named the Vikings starter for Monday's game against the Bills. Murray could become the backup for Minnesota if Wentz plays well.

news.body: Kyler Murray remains up in the air to start Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) may not start in Week 9
news.impact: Murray is still being evaluated for a sore hamstring. Adam Schefter notes that Carson Wentz is trending towards starting Monday's game.

news.body: Vikings QB Kyler Murray is being evaluated for a sore hamstring.
news.head: Kyler Murray dealing with sore hamstring
news.impact: Murray is being fully evaluated to start the week. He is day-to-day for now.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 17-of-29 pass attempts for 210 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for a team-high 35 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Kyler Murray offers mixed results in Week 8 loss to Lions
news.impact: Murray battled hamstring tightness late in Sunday's contest, recording less than 230 passing yards for the third consecutive contest. The athletic quarterback faces a stiff test in Week 9 against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Ravens placed Lamar Jackson on injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) officially placed on IR
news.impact: Jackson is expected to require surgery on his thumb injury. His status to return this season remains up in the air.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will require surgery on his injured thumb and will head to injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb)will need surgery for thumb, heading to IR
news.impact: It’s a brutal loss for the Ravens and fantasy managers depending on Lamar’s return. The Ravens offense struggled to get anything going with Lamar out, and it wasn’t helped when backup Tyler Huntley also went down with injury. Jackson will now miss at least the next four games, and quite possibly more.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday’s contest between the Baltimore Ravens and Buffalo Bills according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Jackson suffered the thumb injury while following through on his lone pass attempt, finishing 0-for-1 through the air. Tyler Huntley takes over behind center against the Bills.

news.body: Lamar Jackson went to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Lamar Jackson headed to locker room Sunday
news.impact: With Jackson making his return, he appeared to hit his hand on a follow through on the Ravens first offensive play of the game. Jackson is officially questionable to return with a thumb injury.

news.body: Malik Willis completed 21-of-32 passes for 211 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Dolphins' 24-19 win over the Patriots. He ran once for two yards.
news.head: Malik Willis tosses two touchdowns in loss to Patriots
news.impact: Willis now has six passing touchdowns to five interceptions on the season, and his season-high in passing yardage is 220 yards, set back in Week 1. The rushing upside is there; we've seen it each of the two weeks prior to this one, but in games like Sunday's, it completely evaporates. He's usable as a QB2, but the hope for a modest passing season with prolific rushing numbers is seeming unlikely.

news.body: Malik Willis was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Malik Willis (groin) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Willis led the Dolphins to their first win last week. He'll remain a QB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Malik Willis completed 14-of-21 passes for 208 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He rushed for 37 yards and a touchdown on eight carries.
news.head: Malik Willis tallies three touchdowns in Week 7 win
news.impact: Willis found Caleb Douglas for both of his touchdowns Sunday to propel the Dolphins to their first win of the season. Willis and the Dolphins will look to build on their success in a Week 8 matchup against New England.

news.body: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said there's no thought of benching Malik Willis at this point.
news.head: Malik Willis: Dolphins not considering benching QB
news.impact: "We've played five games, and Malik is our quarterback," Hafley said. Willis remains a low-end QB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Matthew Stafford (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Matthew Stafford (elbow) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

news.body: Matthew Stafford was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Matthew Stafford (elbow) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Stafford was reported to be dealing with elbow soreness. He should be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Commanders.

news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay told reporters Matthew Stafford has been dealing with soreness in his right elbow.
news.head: Matthew Stafford dealing with elbow soreness
news.impact: Staffford left the locker room on Sunday with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 17-of-25 passing attempts for 157 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Matthew Stafford scores one touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: Stafford wasn't able to put up big numbers on the stat sheet on Sunday. He racked up just 157 yards and one touchdown over the course of the game, and he also had an interception that worked against him. He is not as strong of a fantasy option with Davante Adams (hamstring) set to be out of the lineup for a while.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. completed 8-of-24 passes for 125 yards with four interceptions in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. throws four interceptions Sunday
news.impact: In one of the weirder games you may ever see, Penix threw almost as many interceptions as completions. Meanwhile Baker Mayfield did not commit a single pass in a win. Penix will be a QB2 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. completed 25 of 34 passes for 213 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. tosses three touchdowns in win over 49ers
news.impact: Penix made himself quite comfortable in this impressive performance, avoiding any sacks and committing no turnovers. Penix had just one three-touchdown game in his career before last week. He has now thrown three in each of the last two games without an interception. The 26-year-old QB has settled in at the helm of the Falcons' offense and is climbing the fantasy ranks.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. completed 19-of-33 pass attempts for 225 yards and three touchdowns while rushing once for one yard and losing a fumble in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Penix Jr. has been mostly reliable behind center in his return to the lineup, throwing for one or more touchdowns in each of his last three contests. The quarterback remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) is off of the Falcons injury report and will play on Sunday against the Bears.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) off injury report, will play Sunday
news.impact: Penix was on the injury report most of the week with a ribs injury but looks good to go against the Bears. He doesn’t have a super high ceiling, and he’s hovered around low-end QB2 territory since returning from injury, but against the Bears soft defense, he could put up a usable performance this week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns while rushing twice for six yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes throws three touchdowns in Week 8
news.impact: Mahomes threw touchdowns to Rashee Rice, Emmett Johnson, and Noah Gray without turning the ball over. He also surpassed 300 passing yards for the first time this season. After failing to throw a touchdown against the Chargers in Week 6, Mahomes returned to QB1 production against Denver. He's back.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 19 of his 33 passes for 165 yards and one interception while adding two rushes for 14 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II struggles vs. Seahawks in Week 7
news.impact: Mahomes and the Kansas City offense struggled in the loss to Seattle on Sunday night as they were held without a touchdown for the first time all season while being dealt their first loss. Mahomes will take nine touchdown passes and four interceptions into his Week 8 matchup against the Broncos.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mahomes will be good to go for Sunday's showdown in Seattle.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception while adding 16 yards on five carries in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes Throws for 272 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Mahomes moved the ball efficiently at 9.1 yards per attempt, but Kenneth Walker III scored both of Kansas City's touchdowns on the ground. The interception didn't help, either, leaving Mahomes with a disappointing fantasy performance despite the Chiefs putting up 422 total yards. There isn't much to overthink here -- Mahomes remains a high-end QB1 going forward.

news.body: Sam Darnold has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals due to a quad injury.
news.head: Sam Darnold (quad) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Darnold suffered a quad injury in Monday's loss against the Bears. Drew Lock will get the start in his place on Sunday.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 17-of-34 passing attempts for 188 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Sam Darnold tosses two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: The veteran didn't have his best game on Monday night. He finished with a solid two touchdowns, but outside of that he had a subpar completion percent, wasn't able to reach 200 passing yards, and threw an interception at one point. This wasn't a great game from Darnold and he remains nothing more than a streaming option moving forward.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 20 of his 28 passes for 257 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding two rushes for 17 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Sam Darnold throws one TD in Week 7
news.impact: Darnold found Jaxon Smith-Njigba for a 28-yard score in the second quarter. The veteran quarterback wasn't perfect but he looked much better than he did in Week 6's overtime loss to the Broncos. Darnold has now thrown eight touchdowns and eight interceptions in six games. He will be a low-end QB2 in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 27-of-51 passes for 278 yards and two interceptions in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also ran twice for 19 yards.
news.head: Sam Darnold struggles in loss to Denver
news.impact: It was not a good night for Darnold, whose performance led to questions of benching, which HC Mike MacDonald quickly shut down. Darnold is still the Seahawks starter, but more will be asked and expected of him in the coming weeks as Seattle looks to right the ship.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence throws for 242 yards in rainy TNF
news.impact: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
news.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence clears 300 yards for the first time this season
news.impact: Lawrence not only passed for a new season-high in yards Sunday, but he also gained 25 yards on the ground for the second time through the first five weeks. Lawrence is averaging just under 235 passing yards per game on the campaign, with a 67.1% completion rate and a 10-3 TD/INT ratio. He'll face the division-rival Texans in Week 6, and remains a definite QB1.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, a touchdown, and a pick in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He was the Saints' leading rusher with seven yards on three carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws for 278 yards in loss
news.impact: Shough didn't have a terrible game, all things considered. He was accurate, put up decent yardage, but was just held out of the end zone. Obviously, that's a big part of fantasy football, but it's also important to remember that because the Saints had no running game, it made things a little tougher for Shough in the passing game.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite still dealing with a hand issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and this issue shouldn't play a big factor for fantasy managers when they weigh whether or not to start him against the Giants this week.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed five times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. held in check in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Jones Sr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 30 yards in each of his last two contests. The running back faces another stiff test against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday and Friday. He will be an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. practiced again on Friday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) practices Friday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday after he missed practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report, but he appears to be on track to being good to go.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returned to Minnesota's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice for the Vikings on Thursday after being sidelined by a knee issue on Wednesday. It remains to be seen whether he was limited or a full participant, but either way this bodes well for his Week 8 availability.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: The veteran will be good to go for Sunday's game, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. He will split work with Kendre Miller this week, but it will be hard to trust starting either of them in most fantasy league formats at this point.

news.body: Alvin Kamara was officially limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Kamara should be good to go for the Saints. He remains a desperation flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Alvin Kamara returned to practice on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) practices Thursday
news.impact: Kamara missed practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report for New Orleans.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) missed New Orleans' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's managing a back issue right now, and the team also wanted to give him the day off for load management purposes. His participation at Thursday's practice should be much more revealing for his Week 9 availability.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for nine yards on two carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 64 yards.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty sees just two carries in Week 8 win
news.impact: Jeanty saw the bulk of the rushing attempts go to Mike Washington Jr. in the win Sunday. After the game, it was made clear that this was the plan and was communicated to Jeanty prior to the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor reports from the Raiders heading into Week 9.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards while also hauling in all eight of his targets for 61 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty finds end zone in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Jeanty has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in each of the last two contests. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of an inconsistent New York Jets offense in Week 8.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed the ball ten times for 22 yards and a touchdown and caught 4-of-6 targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty inefficient in loss Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty ended up having a decent fantasy outing on Sunday between his involvement in the receiving game and his touchdown on the ground. But he was very inefficient on the ground, rushing at a clip of just 2.2 yards per carry, and finished with less rushing yards than Mike Washington Jr., who was more involved than expected again Buffalo. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor Jeanty moving forward, especially to see if he's still dealing with any nagging injuries at this point.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Austin Ekeler carried the ball eight times for 36 yards and ran in a two-point conversion in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Austin Ekeler runs for 36 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Ekeler averaged 4.5 yards per carry but was surprisingly not targeted in the passing game in the win. The veteran running back could see a larger role in Week 9 vs. the Rams as Jeremy McNichols (foot) left Sunday's game with a foot injury and did not return.

news.body: Austin Ekeler carried the ball once for three yards and caught both of his targets for four yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Austin Ekeler sees three touches in Week 6
news.impact: Ekeler mixed in behind Rachaad White in the Washington backfield. The veteran running back should continue to see a handful of touches behind White while Jacory Croskey-Merritt is on injured reserve with a groin injury.

news.body: Austin Ekeler was wearing a non-contact jersey during practice on Friday.
news.head: Austin Ekeler (chest) in non-contact jersey in practice Friday
news.impact: Ekeler was limited in practice on Thursday where he also wore a non-contact jersey. He'll have one more day to practice on Saturday.

news.body: Austin Ekeler (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Austin Ekeler (chest) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice on Thursday, but he was limited due to a chest injury that he's managing. He should be available to play on Monday night still and will see more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is sidelined against San Francisco.

news.body: Bam Knight has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Bam Knight (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Knight remains in concussion protocol. Tyler Allgeier will take over the workhorse role in a tough matchup against Seattle.

news.body: Bam Knight (concussion) was absent from Arizona's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Bam Knight (concussion) absent from practice Wednesday
news.impact: Knight is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was unable to practice on Wednesday as a result. That doesn't bode well for his Week 9 availability, and Tyler Allgeier is primed to be the team's undisputed RB1 on Sunday if Knight is ruled out ahead of game time.

news.body: Bam Knight rushed three times for eight yards while also catching one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
news.head: Bam Knight quiet in Week 8
news.impact: Knight was unable to find much success prior to exiting with an injury, recording less than 25 rushing yards in seven of eight contests. The running back's status will need to be monitored ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Bam Knight rushed seven times for 48 yards, while catching three of five targets for 15 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Bam Knight Leads Cardinals With 48 Rushing Yards
news.impact: Knight averaged 6.9 yards per carry and easily outproduced Tyler Allgeier on the ground, despite Allgeier receiving one more carry. Knight finished with 63 total yards on 10 touches. If this backfield remains split, neither player has a particularly high floor, but Knight was clearly the more effective runner Sunday. So, lean Knight.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran 12 times for 29 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten struggles in rainy game
news.impact: Tuten struggled to get much going in this game, with his longest run being six yards. The Ravens' defense did a good job keeping things in front of them and not allowing many explosive plays by the Jags, and Tuten suffered for it. He will look to have a better time out against the Titans next week.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) is active for the Jaguars Thursday Night Football contest against the Ravens.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) active for Thursday Night Football
news.impact: Fire up the Jaguars RB1, who has been on a hot streak coming into this game and should have ample opportunity to put up points in what should be a blowout.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) should be good to go for TNF barring a pregame setback.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) should be good to go for TNF
news.impact: Tuten looked fine durinf his final touches on Sunday, but practice reports didn’t look especially promising at first. However, his status has improved and it sounds like he will be active for Thursday. Start him if he’s active.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is officially questionable for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) officially questionable for Thursday
news.impact: Tuten wasn't able to practice all week due to an ankle/foot issue that he's dealing with, and now he is officially considered questionable to play on Thursday night because of it. It sounds like he is expected to be a game-time decision, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his status leading up to kickoff and should have a good backup option in place in case he's out.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran for 76 yards on 19 carries in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson runs for 76 yards Sunday
news.impact: Robinson did not catch his lone target. It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. Bijan remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 63 yards on 20 carries and caught all five of his targets for 59 yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson gains 122 yards of total offense in Week 7 win
news.impact: Robinson finished with just over 60 yards on the ground for the second straight week, but he nearly doubled his offensive output with his efforts in the passing game. Robinson hasn't visited the end zone since Week 4, and fantasy managers hope that will change in a Week 8 matchup with the Buccaneers. Robinson remains one of the top overall fantasy assets despite this short dry spell.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball nine times for 61 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of eight yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Bijan Robinson bottled up in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Robinson struggled to make an impact out of the backfield, recording less than 70 offensive yards for the first time in six contests. The running back remains locked in as a strong RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Bijan Robinson gained 86 yards on 17 carries and caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Bijan Robinson totals 118 yards on 21 touches in Week 5
news.impact: Robinson continues to be one of the elite offensive weapons in the league, as the dual-threat back is averaging 116 rushing yards and more than 30 receiving yards per game this season. Robinson scored twice on the ground in both Week 3 and Week 4, but he couldn't keep the TD streak going Sunday night against the Ravens. He will look to start a new one in Week 6 against the Bears.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Blake Corum leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Corum played well on Sunday. He led the team with 73 yards over the course of the game, and he was able to do that while maintaining an efficient clip of 6.6 yards per carry. His touchdown was the cherry on top, and fantasy managers should expect him to continue to see considerable work moving forward, even while sharing the backfield with Kyren Williams.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and one touchdown while also catching his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Blake Corum reaches end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Corum has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one touchdown in each of his last three contests. The dynamic running back remains an impactful option behind No. 1 running back Kyren Williams for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the winless Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball nine times for 42 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Blake Corum scores once in loss Sunday
news.impact: Corum got involved on Sunday, seeing 11 total touches in the team's loss to the Cardinals. He was able to get into the end zone on one of his catches, but he still didn't end up with more than just a solid fantasy total. He will likely continue to serve as an involved RB2 behind Kyren Williams moving forward.

news.body: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.

news.body: Braelon Allen (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Braelon Allen (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Allen will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle injury. He should be a full go in Week 8 and will be New York's primary running back if Breece Hall (quad) is unable to suit up against the Raiders.

news.body: Braelon Allen (ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Braelon Allen (ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Allen was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday after being limited by an ankle issue on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should expect him to be startable again if Breece Hall (quad) is ruled out for another game.

news.body: Braelon Allen will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Braelon Allen to be limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allen and Breece Hall will both be limited to start the practice week. They'll need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Hall is now off of the injury report entirely heading into the weekend, meaning that he is fully good to go and will make his return to the lineup on Sunday. He still has explosive week-to-week potential, but he may be more inconsistent moving forward now that Braelon Allen has earned more touches for himself while serving as the team's temporary RB1.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Hall was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He told reporters that he will be ready to play in Week 9, so fantasy managers should expect to see him out on the field on Sunday, barring any unforeseen setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Breece Hall was practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) practicing Thursday
news.impact: Hall was limited to begin the week on Wednesday. He continues to trend towards making his return for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Hall was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He seems to be very close to a return from his quad injury, but there also remains a slight chance that he will be traded in the near future, so fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status closely throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play in Week 9.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on Injured Reserve.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) placed on Injured Reserve
news.impact: Robinson has missed the last several games with a hamstring injury, and apparently hasn’t made enough progress for the team to keep him off of IR. He will miss at least the next four games. The Falcons will need to elevate someone to back up Bijan Robinson.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Robinson was also limited on Wednesday. He is trending towards having a chance to return this week for the Falcons.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) was listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
news.impact: Robinson has missed the last two weeks due to a hamstring injury, but this is a positive development for the Falcons' No. 2 RB. Robinson has been solid behind dual-threat star Bijan Robinson this season. Brian Robinson has averaged 4.0 yards per carry for more than 200 yards and four touchdowns in six games.

news.body: Falcons RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) is officially inactive for a Week 8 matchup with Tampa Bay.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) officially inactive for Week 8
news.impact: Robinson was unable to practice in any capacity this week and will not suit up for the Falcons. Khalil Herbert will serve as the backup against Tampa Bay.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Bucky Irving explodes for 170 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was the Irving and Kenneth Gainwell show all afternoon as Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. Irving saw career-highs in both carries and yardage. He also had a second touchdown taken away on a fumble at the goal line. He'll be a borderline RB1 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Bucky Irving did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (rest) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: It was a rest day for Irving. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran 24 times for 106 yards and two touchdowns in the Bucs' 43-13 win over Carolina. He also caught one of two targets for four yards.
news.head: Bucky Irving gashes Carolina in win
news.impact: Irving has put up strong performances of late, with 100+ rushing yards and 1+ rushing touchdowns in two of his last three games played. He's firmly in RB2 territory with RB1 upside.

news.body: Bucky Irving (illness) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (illness) back at practice Thursday
news.impact: Irving is currently recovering from an illness of some kind and missed Wednesday's practice as a result, but he was back at practice on Thursday and participated in a limited capacity. That's a good sign that he will be fully good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) is doubtful to play in Sunday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful to play Sunday
news.impact: Skattebo wasn't able to practice on Friday and is officially considered doubtful to play heading into the weekend. It remains to be seen if he will miss more time beyond this game due to his hamstring issue, and fantasy managers should expect Devin Singletary to serve as the team's clear-cut RB1 in his absence.

news.body: Cam Skattebo did not practice again on Friday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) officially misses practice Friday
news.impact: Skattebo officially missed practice all week. Giants coach John Harbaugh wasn't ready to rule him out for Sunday against the Eagles.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) was spotted at practice for the New York Giants Friday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) spotted at practice Friday
news.impact: Skattebo did not see any touches on the practice field for head coach John Harbaugh, as the second-year running back continues to battle a combination of injuries and ball security issues in the Giants backfield.

news.body: Cam Skattebo was working with trainers on the side during practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer in practice Thursday
news.impact: Skattebo will likely be listed as a non-participant in practice again on Thursday. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.

news.body: Chase Brown carried the ball 12 times for 55 yards while catching eight of his nine targets for 46 yards and losing a fumble in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Chase Brown catches eight passes in Week 8
news.impact: Brown did most of his damage in the passing game in the thrilling win over Tennessee. More importantly, he out-touched Samaje Perine 20-to-five in the contest after Perine had been cutting into his workload in recent weeks. Brown will continue to be a low-end RB1/high-end RB2 as he prepares to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 39 yards on 11 carries in a 35-13 win over the Ravens. He caught 4-of-5 passes for 19 yards.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 15 touches in Week 7 win
news.impact: Brown continues to struggle in the running game and saw Samaje Perine get the goal line carry that resulted in the Bengals' lone rushing touchdown. Brown has not eclipsed 50 rushing yards since Week 3 and has failed to find the end zone since Week 1. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 13 times for 39 yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Chase Brown underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: The young running back wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He totaled 50 yards over his 17 opportunities, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy total. He should bounce back and look better after Cincinnati's bye week this week, but his production may continue to be inconsistent moving forward.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball nine times for ten yards and hauled in 11 catches for 71 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Chase Brown hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Brown was very ineffective as a rusher on Sunday, finishing with just ten yards in a loss to the Jaguars. He was able to contribute heavily through the passing game, however, logging 71 yards on a whopping 11 catches. The Bengals may need to lean on him in the passing game again next week with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at risk to be sidelined against the Dolphins.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 10 times fo 19 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also caught both of his targets for 13 yards.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. hammers in touchdown in win over Ravens
news.impact: Rodriguez matched Bhayshul Tuten for touches, but crucially got the receiving work, giving him the edge in half- and full-PPR formats. He's heavily touchdown-dependent, but the good news is he could see another chance to score against the Titans next week if the Jags can build up a big lead.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) good to go for Thursday
news.impact: Rodriguez was limited at practice all week due to a hand issue, but it's not a serious issue and he is officially good to go for Thursday night's game. Look for him to see a lot more work than usual if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is ruled out against the Ravens.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Rodriguez is on track to be good to go for Thursday’s game against the Ravens. He could be in line for an expanded role with Bhayshul Tuten still sidelined from practice on Tuesday.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on six carries, adding in a 17-yard reception in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez hits paydirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Rodriguez continues to be a solid change-of-pace back for the Jaguars. The fourth-year ball carrier scored his third touchdown of the season in the third quarter of this contest, sprinting from 28 yards out for his longest gain of the campaign to date. Rodriguez is averaging 4.6 yards on his 45 carries so far this season and should be considered a top-tier handcuff.
