news.impact: Kelce led the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards while tying for the lead in catches in the disappointing loss. The veteran tight end has notched at least 44 receiving yards in five of his six games this year. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in seven of his eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Trey McBride finds end zone in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: McBride has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in three of his last four contests. The tight end remains locked in as a reliable TE1 option ahead of a Week 9 matchup against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Trey McBride Goes Over 100 Yards, Scores in Week 7
news.impact: McBride accounted for 10 of Jacoby Brissett's 27 completions and 111 of his 272 passing yards. He also caught Arizona's only touchdown, scoring from seven yards out in the third quarter. With 13 targets and no other Cardinal seeing more than eight, McBride remains one of fantasy football's safest elite TE1 options.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McBride continues to produce well in PPR scoring formats, hauling in seven passes in Sunday's upset win over the Rams. He wasn't able to turn those seven catches into much, but fantasy managers should still be satisfied with the performance that he put up.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The star tight end played well on Sunday. He was able to record 66 yards and a touchdown on his nine catches, which left him with a great fantasy total on the afternoon. He should continue to be great moving forward, even with Arizona not expected to win many games over the course of the season.

news.body: Tucker Kraft secured all six of his targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Tucker Kraft scores again in Week 8
news.impact: Kraft scored for the second consecutive game and the third time this season in Thursday night's win. The fourth-year TE has now caught between 4-6 passes in six straight weeks, and though he hasn't gone over 65 yards in any game this season, Kraft remains a solid TE1.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in 4-of-6 targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Kraft had a solid game on Sunday. He was able to haul in four passes for 49 yards on the afternoon, one of which he was able to get into the end zone on as well. He should continue to be viewed as a weekly starter at the tight end position moving forward.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Tucker Kraft catches five passes in Week 6
news.impact: Kraft finished tied for second on the team in targets but was able to manage just 37 yards in the win. The veteran tight end now has 25 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown in six games for the Packers this year. He will be a strong TE1 in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught all five of his targets for 64 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Tucker Kraft sees six touches in Week 5
news.impact: Kraft has seen increased involvement in the Green Bay passing attack of late, logging five or more targets in each of his last three contests. The tight end will look to offer more impactful output moving forward, with a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys up next.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught 1-of-2 targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Tyler Higbee underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Higbee wasn't able to get much going on Sunday, finishing with just one catch for 14 yards in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him on a weekly basis with how lacking his production has been over the past couple of weeks.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Tyler Higbee quiet in Week 7 win
news.impact: Higbee has cooled off of late, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a banged-up Rams offense, with a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught four passes for 22 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Higbee caught four passes over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them, racking up just 22 yards in a loss to the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Tyler Higbee is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

news.body: Tyler Warren managed to catch just 4-of-10 targets for only 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren struggles in return from injury
news.impact: After missing each of the last two games due to a groin injury, Warren was back on the field for the Colts in Week 8. It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.

news.body: Tyler Warren will play on Sunday against the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: Warren will return from a two-game absence. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) limited at practice again Thursday
news.impact: Warren has missed some time while recovering from a groin issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion for a second-straight day on Thursday. That's a good sign that he's trending the right way for Week 8, but we won't know his official injury status until later on in the week.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Warren was able to participate in Wednesday's practice. He has missed multiple games while dealing with this groin issue, but it looks like he's trending towards making his return in Week 8. He will be a must-start fantasy option if active, even with Indianapolis getting rid of several key players for future picks.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught 7-of-9 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell held without a reception in Week 7
news.impact: Mitchell was held without a catch in his return from a finger injury. He was overshadowed by an excellent performance from Omar Cooper. Fantasy managers can leave Mitchell out of their lineups in Week 8.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will play Sunday against the Dolphins.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will return in Week 7
news.impact: Mitchell has not played since Week 2, but he has been practicing this week and will return to the field Sunday. Mitchell was off to a strong start for the Jets this season, hauling in 9-of-15 targets for 123 yards over the first two games. With Garrett Wilson and rookie Omar Cooper Jr. both out there as well, it will be interesting to see how Mitchell works back into the mix.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (finger) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: Mitchell was again a limited participant at practice on Thursday, as he's still working his way back from a finger injury that has left him sidelined for multiple weeks. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 7, but we likely won't know his official status until after practice on Friday.

news.body: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday’s matchup between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Brown will sit out after being unable to take the practice field for head coach Mike Vrabel, with DeMario Douglas in line for increased targets against targets as the No. 1 wideout against the Packers Sunday.

news.body: A.J. Brown did not practice again on Thursday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Brown is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: A.J. Brown is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) will not practice Wednesday
news.impact: Brown was hopeful to practice this week. He will need to be monitored on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said "we'll see how he progresses" when asked if A.J. Brown will return to practice this week.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) hopeful to practice this week
news.impact: Brown did not play in Sunday's win over the Dolphins. He remains up in the air heading into Week 9.

news.body: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Alec Pierce will not practice this week.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) will not practice this week
news.impact: Pierce remains without a clear timetable to return. He is week-to-week.

news.body: Colts WR Alec Pierce is still a few weeks away from a return to game action.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) weeks away from returning
news.impact: Pierce was able to get out of his cast earlier this week. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Alec Pierce is reportedly no longer wearing a cast but is not close to a return.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) out of cast, not close to returning
news.impact: Pierce went on injured reserve with a heel injury after Week 2. He has his first chance to return in the Colts’ Week 7 game against the Vikings.

news.body: Alec Pierce (heel) will be placed on IR and has no projected timetable for recovery.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) to be placed on IR
news.impact: This was an expected move by the Colts. Pierce is attempting to rehab his heel injury instead of undergoing surgery. The big-play wide receiver will miss at least four weeks, and probably longer. Veteran receiver Darius Slayton was signed by the Colts earier this week.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout is at risk of missing Sunday's game due to a rib injury that he suffered last week. He is officially questionable to play, and if he is ruled out ahead of game time, fantasy managers should expect more work for Jameson Williams, Sam LaPorta, and Isaac TeSlaa in a matchup against Miami this week.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) was limited at Detroit's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: St. Brown was estimated to be a limited participant on Wednesday's injury report. He suffered a rib injury in Week 8, but he was able to finish the game, so it looks likely that he will be able to play through it in Week 9, though we won't know for sure until later on in the week. He remains a must-start if he's cleared to play this week.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in seven of his team-leading eight targets for 46 yards while also rushing once for 10 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauls in seven passes in Week 8 win
news.impact: St. Brown was held in check by a stiff Minnesota defense, recording less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last four contests in the win. The wideout remains a stable WR1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (head/knee) has returned to Sunday’s contest between the Detroit Lions and Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (head/knee) returns to sideline Sunday
news.impact: St. Brown exited in the first quarter while being evaluated for multiple injuries, but looks good to go for head coach Dan Campbell against a fierce Vikings defense.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught five of his seven targets for 54 yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Antonio Williams goes for 54 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Williams moved into a starting role with the Commanders playing their first game since losing Terry McLaurin to a season-ending knee injury. The rookie responded well, finishing second on the team in receiving yards while leading the way with seven targets. Williams becomes interesting in fantasy moving forward as he gears up to take on the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6
news.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie with the New York Giants in Week 5.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of the last four games. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option in the Washington offense for head coach Dan Quinn, with a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
news.head: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Williams was second on the team in targets, just one behind Stefon Diggs. Williams could continue to see more playing time next week if Terry McLaurin does not return from his hamstring injury.

news.body: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandin Cooks caught one pass for 13 yards for the second week in a row in a Week 7 loss to the Atlanta Falcons
news.head: Brandin Cooks snags one pass in Week 7
news.impact: Cooks had another quiet week despite a season-high snap rate, appearing on 68% of the offensive plays. The 49ers are desperate for healthy wide receivers, but that doesn't mean they're going to make an impact. Quarterback Brock Purdy completed 27 passes — seven were caught by a wide receiver, a trend that could continue.

news.body: Brandin Cooks caught one of his two targets for 13 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: Brandin Cooks hauls in 13-yard pass in Week 6
news.impact: Cooks was quiet in the win on Monday night despite Mike Evans leaving the game right before halftime with Achilles soreness. The 49ers leaned on Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle in the passing game in Evans' absence while Cooks was held to just one catch. Cooks is worth a roster spot in deeper leagues, but he should not be in starting lineups heading into Week 7's matchup vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Brandin Cooks hauled in a seven-yard touchdown on Sunday against the Seahawks.
news.head: Brandin Cooks catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Cooks took advantage of the opportunity with 49ers wide receivers going down with injuries. He could see some more opportunity heading into Week 6 against the Commanders, but he remains off the fantasy radar for now.

news.body: The 49ers signed WR Brandin Cooks to their practice squad.
news.head: Brandin Cooks signs with 49ers practice squad
news.impact: Cooks will be entering year 13 in the NFL. He'll add depth in the wide receiver room for San Francisco.

news.body: Brandon Aiyuk has filed for reinstatement and is prepared to rejoin the 49ers on Friday.
news.head: Brandon Aiyuk files for reinstatement with the NFL
news.impact: The Aiyuk saga continues around San Francisco. The veteran wide receiver has been on the left squad list since the summer, but the 49ers will now have to make a decision to keep, cut, or, if possible, trade him. Aiyuk has not played in an NFL game since 2024.

news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said Brandon Aiyuk remains on the left squad list.
news.head: Brandon Aiyuk remains on left squad list
news.impact: Lynch declined to say anything about the Aiyuk other than: “I’m personally, and we as an organization, are going to focus on the players who are here,” Lynch said. “We wish him well, we wish his family well.”

news.body: Brandon Aiyuk has had a warrant for his arrest issued in Northern California due to misdemeanor charge for speeding. This comes after an investigation into a video posted by Aiyuk showing him speeding near Levi Stadium.
news.head: Brandon Aiyuk: has warrant issued for speeding
news.impact: It’s yet another feather in Aiyuk’s trouble making cap. Whether he comes under discipline by the NFL, and how, remains to be seen. Either way, this will hurt his stock even further; if any team was holding out interest in trading for him, that has likely taken a hit. He was already on the outs with the 49ers, he might have played himself, off the field that is, out of the league. That’s certainly an extreme stance, regardless, things aren’t looking any better for the talented but troubled receiver.

news.body: Cam Inman of The Mercury News' reported that 49ers WR Brandon Aiyuk “is expected to be released if not traded by summer’s end.”
news.head: Brandon Aiyuk expected to be released or traded by 'summer's end'
news.impact: The news on Aiyuk as of late has been fairly quiet. It is possible he could be released by next week if he doesn't show up to the 49ers first organized team activities session on May 27th.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. was not targeted in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. held without a target in win
news.impact: Thomas caught a touchdown on Sunday, and was held without a target on Thursday. The "downfield threat," as the Jaguars coaching staff has called him, has only 117 yards all season and can be safely dropped, unless you want to hold and hope he gets traded before the deadline.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught 1-of-2 targets for a 12-yard touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 rout of the Colts.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. finds the end zone in Week 8 win
news.impact: With trade rumors swirling around him, Thomas was certainly still part of the plan for the Jaguars on Sunday. He hauled in his second touchdown of the campaign, scoring from 12 yards out on the team's opening drive. Thomas only saw two targets on the day, but no Jaguars player received more than three. He's still not a player to throw right back into fantasy lineups, but Thomas should be kept on the radar.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. was held without a catch on two targets in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. vanishes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Thomas has now been held without a catch in two consecutive games, and did not see an offensive snap after halftime. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable benching Thomas, or at least moving on when the Jaguars return after their Week 7 bye.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. did not record a reception on three targets in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. puts up a goose egg in Week 5
news.impact: It is noteworthy that Thomas came up just a sideline toe touch short of scoring for the second straight week in this game. Still, Thomas has seen only six combined targets over the last three contests, and he seems to be in just a complementary role for the Jaguars at the moment.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas comes down to earth in loss
news.impact: Douglas came back down to earth on Sunday, though a four for 43 yards is just fine in real life for a rookie. His efficiency had been insane, so it was bound to come down at some point. He's going to have a better matchup next week against the Lions and could be a flex play in that spot.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas finds the end zone twice in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on a seven yard reception and a 63-yard reception to help pace the Dolphins to their first win of the season. This marked the first game Douglas has played in since suffering an injury in Week 2, and he provided an immediate jolt in the Dolphins' passing attack. Douglas will look to build on this performance against the Patriots in Week 8.

news.body: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) is expected to play against the Jets on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) expected to play in Week 7
news.impact: After a strong NFL debut back in Week 1, Douglas was knocked out early in his second career game and has not played for the Dolphins since. That should change this week, as the rookie has been active at practice leading into a divisional matchup against the Jets. Fellow rookie Kevin Coleman Jr. likely stands to lose snaps if Douglas does return.

news.body: Carnell Tate has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Tate was unable to practice all week. Wan’Dale Robinson will be in the WR3/flex conversation even more so this week.

news.body: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is not practicing for the Tennessee Titans Friday according to Turron Davenport.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Tate continues to battle a lingering shoulder injury for head coach Robert Saleh, leaving the rookie wideout’s status in doubt for Sunday.

news.body: Carnell Tate did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) misses practice again Thursday
news.impact: Tate missed a second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

news.body: Carnell Tate missed practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Tate is dealing with a shoulder injury. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 11 targets for 58 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Lamb was held mostly in check Sunday, finishing under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last three contests. The wideout remains locked in as an elite WR1 option against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught nine of his 18 targets for 70 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 70 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Lamb drew an impressive number of targets but was inefficient with the workload, catching just half of them while averaging just 7.8 yards per catch. The veteran wideout now has 48 catches for 577 yards and four touchdowns through six games. He will be a high-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb is practicing in full for Week 6 against the Packers.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb (quad) practicing in full for Week 6
news.impact: Lamb left the game late last week with a quad injury. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: Chris Bell caught four of five targets for 31 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Bell hauls in four passes in loss to New England
news.impact: Bell now has back-to-back games with 3+ catches and 25+ receiving yards, hinting that he's not only becoming more involved but healthier and more up to speed. The rookie was always going to have to take some time to get over the ACL tear he sustained in his final year of college, and we might be watching the beginnings of a breakout.

news.body: Chris Bell caught 3-of-4 targets for 25 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Chris Bell hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Bell caught his first pass since Week 3, but was not heavily featured in the Dolphins' passing attack. Fantasy managers should look elsewhere for wide receiver production for now.

news.body: Chris Bell failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Chris Bell held catchless in loss Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a terrible showing on Sunday, being held without a catch for a second-straight week. He was able to pick up 26 yards on his lone rush attempt, but that did nothing to fix his lack of production as a receiver. He should not be started in nearly any league format at this point in the season.

news.body: Chris Bell (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Chris Bell (knee) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Bell was able to participate in a limited fashion at practice on Thursday, which was to be expected, given that the injury is not considered more than a minor issue at this point. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 5, but fantasy managers shouldn't consider him more than a streaming option at this point in the season.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass in the win on Sunday. Godwin has struggled all season regardless of the circumstances. He'll be a WR4/WR5 moving forward.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes in win
news.impact: While the final stat line is a bit disappointing considering Emeka Egbuka did not play, it's important to remember Baker Mayfield threw only 11 passes for 64 yards. Godwin had a 45% target share and a 42% receiving yards share with those numbers. So again, nothing much to write home about in the final box score, but his actual market share was great. He could be interesting next week against the Falcons

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-8 targets for 37 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Godwin was second on the team in targets, but it didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday. He also ran once for three yards.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. snags three passes in win
news.impact: Godwin started off hot with two catches on the first drive, but fizzled out quickly with only a single catch the rest of the way. Emeka Egbuka was the favorite target of rookie QB Jaylon Daniels, with Godwin sitting tied for third on the team in targets behind Cade Otton and Kenny Gainwell. Godwin is a risky start at this point, and his value is more closely tied to real life than to fantasy.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 4-of-7 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

news.body: Chris Olave is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Olave returned to practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Watson suffered a broken rib last week, but it's not going to prevent him from playing this week and he is officially good to go for Sunday's game. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him this week in what projects to be a high-scoring affair in New England this weekend.

news.body: Christian Watson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Watson is continuing to trend towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Watson suffered a rib injury in Green Bay's win over the Panthers last week, which left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's on track to be a full go for Week 9, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Christian Watson is practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Watson left last Thursday’s game early before eventually returning later in the game. He is on track to be good to go this week.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught one pass for seven yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Cooper Kupp finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Kupp was able to catch a touchdown on Monday night, but that was his only reception, so he still had a terrible fantasy total over the course of the game. He remains entirely off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 20 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Kupp was quiet just one week after drawing 10 targets vs. the Broncos. The veteran wideout continues to operate as Seattle's No. 2 receiver, although the majority of the work goes to Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Kupp will be a low-end flex option in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught five of ten targets for 50 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 50 yards in loss
news.impact: Kupp had arguably his best game of the season, with season-highs in targets, receptions, and yards, lacking only a touchdown. He is a bit of a risky start most weeks, as his volume has been low for the most part. A near 20% target share this week is a nice sign of life, but we will need to see more consistency to really feel comfortable starting him.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp part of crazy ending Sunday
news.impact: On 4th-and-10 with the game on the line, Kupp caught an 8-yard pass, made one defender miss and dove for the first down. After review, he wound up being short by one yard. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
news.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches two passes in win
news.impact: Sutton was quiet in this game, though there wasn't much to go around when the team combined for 107 passing yards. It's been a rough start to the year for QB Bo Nix, and until he improves, the pass catchers will suffer.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught 2-of-3 targets for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches first touchdown of the season
news.impact: Sutton found the end zone for the first time this season during Sunday's win, but the veteran receiver still hasn't really gotten going. Sutton has finished with three or fewer receptions in all five weeks so far. He's also topped out at 46 yards. Sutton cannot be relied upon for much fantasy production in the Broncos' lackluster passing attack right now.

news.body: Cyrus Allen caught one of his two targets for an 18-yard gain in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Cyrus Allen brings in 18-yard pass in Week 7
news.impact: Despite an increased role due to injuries, Allen has just three catches for 45 yards over his past two games. The rookie wideout does not need to be rostered in most fantasy leagues heading into Week 8 against the Broncos.

news.body: Cyrus Allen was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Cyrus Allen (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allen is likely to be good to go on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Cyrus Allen didn't see a target or touch in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Cyrus Allen entirely uninvolved Sunday
news.impact: The rookie saw very little involvement for a second-straight game on Sunday night, which makes him unlikely to be productive for the foreseeable future. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable dropping him in favor of someone who has been getting more work for the first couple games of the season.

news.body: Cyrus Allen did not haul in his lone target in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Cyrus Allen held catchless in win Monday
news.impact: The rookie was silent in his NFL debut on Monday, being held without a catch in the team's big win over the Broncos. They didn't need to pass much in this matchup, so it's possible that he will improve and play better in closer games moving forward. Still, this was a discouraging debut from a utilization standpoint, and fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught two of his six targets for 19 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Darius Cooper catches two passes in Week 8
news.impact: Cooper tied for second on the team with his six targets but he wasn't able to do much with the chances on Sunday night. The veteran now has 11 catches for 175 yards and four touchdowns in eight games this year. He will be a low-end flex in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught 1-of-3 targets for just 17 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Darius Cooper quiet in loss Monday
news.impact: The Eagles weren't able to get Cooper going on Monday, as he finished with just 17 yards in this loss to their divisional rival. He will likely have a couple of boom games over the remainder of the season, but fantasy managers shouldn't trust him at this point.

news.body: Darius Cooper brought down 2-of-3 targets for 71 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Darius Cooper finds the end zone again in Week 5
news.impact: With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) missing each of the last two games, Cooper has now hit paydirt three times over the last two weeks and four times this season. The second-year pro is certainly proving himself as a big-play option for QB Jalen Hurts, but Cooper is still limited in the volume of targets thrown his way.

news.body: Darius Cooper hauled in 3-of-7 targets for 33 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Darius Cooper hauls in two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Cooper was one of the lone bright spots on Philadelphia's offense on Sunday. He caught both of the team's passing touchdowns against the Rams, although he was only able to rack up 33 yards in the process. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a good fantasy option moving forward, however, especially with DeVonta Smith (hamstring) set to make his return to the lineup at some point.

news.body: Darnell Mooney did not catch either of his two targets in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Darnell Mooney does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Mooney had one carry for 20 yards. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Darnell Mooney (neck) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Darnell Mooney (neck) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: The veteran was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday, despite being limited by a neck issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6 but will continue to be irrelevant from a fantasy perspective moving forward.

news.body: Darnell Mooney was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Darnell Mooney (neck) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mooney remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Darnell Mooney caught two of his seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Darnell Mooney quiet in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Mooney has underwhelmed to begin the season in the New York offense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in each of the first five contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Davante Adams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Davante Adams off injury report Monday
news.impact: Adams received a rest day in practice during the week. He'll remain a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Samuel Sr. will sit out once again for head coach Kyle Shanahan with an eye towards returning in Week 10, with Brandin Cooks and Demarcus Robinson (ankle) in line to lead a banged-up wideout group against the Raiders Sunday.

news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said it’s unlikely that Deebo Samuel Sr. will play in Week 9 against the Raiders.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) not expected to return in Week 9
news.impact: Mike Evans is also not expected to play. Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters he expects Deebo Samuel Sr. to be good to go following the 49ers Week 8 bye week.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to return after bye week
news.impact: Samuel hasn’t practiced since injuring his hamstring in the 49ers Week 5 win over the Seahawks. He'll hope to return after the bye week.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play Sunday
news.impact: As expected, the veteran is going to miss another game on Sunday as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury. QB Brock Purdy doesn't project to be as strong of a fantasy option this week with him and Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for this matchup against the Falcons.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads Patriots WRs in win
news.impact: Douglas led the Patriots in receiving yards and tied for third on the team in targets with two other players: Hunter Henry and Rhamondre Stevenson. Douglas made his targets count, though, with a 48 yard score being the highlight of his night. Should AJ Brown continue to miss time, Douglas seems to be a safe bet for targets and production.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards and two touchdowns in the Patriots win over Las Vegas.
news.head: DeMario Douglas hits pay dirt twice in Week 5 win
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on receptions of eight and 35-yards, accounting for his first scores of the season. Douglas has an opportunity to become a key component of the offense with AJ Brown and Mack Hollins on injured reserve. Douglas and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Denzel Boston (calf) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Denzel Boston (calf) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, the rookie's calf injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 9. He's still a risky fantasy option on a week-to-week basis, however, especially with Shedeur Sanders set to be Cleveland's starting quarterback this week.

news.body: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (calf) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie was a limited participant on Wednesday. He's managing a calf issue right now, but it doesn't seem to be serious enough to threaten his availability for Week 9. If active on Sunday, his target share may look different with Shedeur Sanders set to be the starting quarterback for the Browns.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught 6-of-11 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Denzel Boston hauls in six passes Sunday
news.impact: Boston was second only behind Harold Fannin on the team in targets. He was unable to turn any of them into big gains. He remains on the WR3/WR4 radar for fantasy managers as a volatile week-to-week play.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught three of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Denzel Boston catches three balls in Week 7
news.impact: Boston drew a healthy eight targets but he wasn't able to do much with the opportunities while fellow rookie KC Concepcion posted a career day with eight catches for 129 yards. Boston now has 20 catches for 372 yards and three touchdowns in seven games this year. He will be a flex option in Week 8 against the Steelers.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Devaughn Vele totals 42 yards Sunday
news.impact: Vele was the second-leading receiver on the day for New Orleans. He is a borderline flex play in games where the passing volume is low for the Saints.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught four of his six targets for 26 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Devaughn Vele bottled up in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Vele has made an inconsistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout will look to get back on track for head coach Kellen Moore in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 6-of-9 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Devaughn Vele finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Vele's strong start to the season continued on Monday night. He caught six passes for 54 yards over the course of the game, one of which he was able to take to the house for a touchdown. He will continue to have solid week-to-week upside until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is back in the lineup for the Saints.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Smith was absent from another practice on Friday and has been ruled out for Sunday's game, which comes as no surprise. It's unclear how much longer he will need to recover from this hamstring issue, and Makai Lemon is expected to be Philadelphia's WR1 again this week with both Smith and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) set to be sidelined again.

news.body: DeVonta Smith is not practicing on Thursday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Smith is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.

news.body: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Smith will miss another game for the Eagles alongside Dontayvion Wicks. They both remain week-to-week.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not practicing for the Philadelphia Eagles Friday according to Jimmy Kempski.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Smith has yet to take the practice field for head coach Nick Sirianni, leaving the wideout’s status question entering the weekend.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-7 targets for 82 yards and a touchdown in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore hauls in TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Moore found the end zone on an 11-yard reception early in the fourth quarter. Moore did indicate after the game that he was fine after leaving the game late with a knee injury. Moore and the Bills take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 8
news.impact: Moore is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, boosting a Buffalo passing attack for quarterback Josh Allen against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is expected to play for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Moore looks poised to return from a two-game absence barring any pregame setbacks, offering quarterback Josh Allen an impactful pass-catching option against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore was listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Moore has been limited in practice throughout the week. He should have a good chance of returning off the bye week. He'll be a WR2 play in a potential shootout.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 1-of-6 targets for four yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: DK Metcalf drops pass that leads to interception Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf dropped an open pass that was going for over 30 yards. He not only dropped the pass, but the ball also bounced off him and resulted in an interception. He is an upside WR3 with a low floor for fantasy managers.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught two of six targets for 56 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in big 51 yarder in win
news.impact: Metcalf has been very up and down this season, with a big 115 yard performance against Cleveland followed up by 12 yards the following week, then an 11-for-93 stat line last Sunday, and finally two for 56 this Sunday. He's a boom-bust receiver for now; if you can afford to let him have his ups and downs, then he's a fine start. But more than likely, he's a risky flex at best.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

news.body: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught all three of his targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers goes for 34 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers had a solid afternoon as the Bengals' No. 3 receiver. While he won't see much work stuck behind Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Meyers has shown that he has enough talent to earn a role in the NFL. He will now prepare to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for just 12 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Meyers has flashed some potential recently, but he wasn't able to build on his momentum on Sunday, finishing with just 12 yards in a win over the Dolphins. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high hopes that he will be fantasy relevant anytime soon.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 82 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers racks up 82 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Meyers stepped up in a big way on Sunday. He finished with 82 yards on seven catches against the Jaguars, although that wasn't enough to propel the Bengals to a win. They will likely need to rely on him more moving forward with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both currently at risk of missing time due to injuries.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) won't play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) won't play Sunday
news.impact: Wicks is going to miss another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from an ankle injury of some kind, and it's unclear how much longer it will leave him sidelined. DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has also been ruled out, which will leave rookie Makai Lemon as Philadelphia's top wideout again this week.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Wicks is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Wicks will miss another game for the Eagles alongside DeVonta Smith. They both remain week-to-week.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (knee) is not practicing for the Philadelphia Eagles Friday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (knee) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Wicks joins fellow wideout DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in being unable to take the practice field for head coach Nick Sirianni, setting up Makai Lemon to see plenty of targets in Week 8.

news.body: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Drake London hauled in four of his team-leading 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Drake London sees 10 targets in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: London continues to make the most of his role as the primary option in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack, registering 10 or more targets in three of the last four contests. The wideout will look to make a more explosive impact in a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Drake London eclipses 100 yards in Sunday's loss
news.impact: London went over 100 yards for the second time in three weeks Sunday night, and he only missed the mark by four yards in Week 4. Surprisingly, London has still yet to find the end zone on any of his 27 grabs this season. London has looked nothing less than a WR1 with Michael Penix at QB for the Falcons. Unfortunately, Penix (ribs) is now dealing with another injury.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught all five of his targets for 37 yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Efton Chism III snags five passes in win
news.impact: Chism led the Patriots in targets and receptions in this game, posting a modest 37-yard total as a result. He could be back in as a sneaky PPR flex should AJ Brown continue to miss time, but his floor and ceiling seem to be fairly low at this point in time.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 5-of-6 targets for 57 yards in the Patriots win over the Raiders. He added two rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Efton Chism III hauls in five passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Chism led the team in targets with six, setting an new season high in targets, yards, and receptions. With Mack Hollins and AJ Brown on injured reserve, Chism appears to be carving out a role in the offense.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 17
news.impact: Chism caught a 10-yard pass for a touchdown in the third quarter, accounting for his first career score. The Patriots were depleted at wide receiver, giving Chism an opportunity to play on offense. The rookie will look to build on this performance in Week 18 against Miami.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka will head into the weekend with a questionable tag. It seems like there's a lot of optimism surrounding his status, but he is officially considered questionable to play at this point. It may be hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him this week, however, especially with him playing on Sunday night after the main slate of games.

news.body: Bucs coach Todd Bowles said Emeka Egbuka will be a game-time decision on Sunday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) to be game-time decision Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka was able to return to a full practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into the weekend.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka is back at practice on Thursday and testing his injured foot.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka at practice testing injured foot Thursday
news.impact: Auman notes that Egbuka was running at full speed on the side Wednesday. He will need to be monitored on the official injury report later in the afternoon.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka was not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Egbuka cleared concussion protocol last week, but he was still ruled out for a foot/ankle injury. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.

news.body: Garrett Wilson (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday’s matchup between the New York Jets and Kansas City Chiefs according to Rich Cimini.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Wilson will be sidelined for head coach Aaron Glenn after being unable to progress through concussion issues throughout the week, setting up Adonai Mitchell and Omari Cooper for increased targets against the Chiefs Sunday.

news.body: Garrett Wilson was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Wilson continues to trend in the wrong direction to play this week as he remains in concussion protocol.

news.body: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Wilson was recently placed in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like a long shot that he will be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game, and if he's ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. should both see a substantial increase in opportunities in his absence.

news.body: The Jets placed WR Garrett Wilson in concussion protocol.
news.head: Garrett Wilson placed in concussion protocol
news.impact: Wilson sustained a head injury in Week 8 against the Raiders. His status for this week is all of a sudden up in the air. If he is ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. could both step into bigger roles.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Pickens popped up on the injury report earlier in the week due to a hamstring issue, and it is going to leave him questionable to play heading into the weekend. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his status and should expect Jake Ferguson (ankle) and Ryan Flournoy to both benefit if the star wideout is unable to play against Indianapolis.

news.body: George Pickens was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: George Pickens limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Pickens is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts. He'll remain a volatile WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Pickens caught two of his four targets for 48 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: George Pickens quiet in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Pickens has fallen back to earth of late, finishing under 60 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The wideout will look to take advantage of a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is officially active for Week 8 for the Dallas Cowboys against the Arizona Cardinals according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) active for Week 8
news.impact: Pickens is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation for head coach Brian Schottenheimer, boosting a Dallas passing offense that will look to feast on the Cardinals defense Sunday.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 5-of-5 targets for 30 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Germie Bernard catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Bernard hauled in all five targets that went his way. He remains in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers while Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson both remain sidelined.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Germie Bernard snags three passes in win over Saints
news.impact: After two great weeks in a row, Bernard was largely held in check by the Saints defense in this one, limited to three short yardage catches. There will be better days ahead, but one thing to keep note of is that the Steelers will have to start getting him some space downfield rather than the short dink-and-dunk targets he's had recently.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 11-of-12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Germie Bernard finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Bernard took full advantage of his extended opportunity with both Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve. He scored the wining touchdown in OT as well that he hauled in from Aaron Rodgers. He'll be on the WR3/flex range heading into next week against the Titans.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said 'football comes easy' to Germie Bernard.
news.head: Germie Bernard draws praise from HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: "He's acclimated very well to the offense, can play all three positions, and sticks his nose in there," McCarthy said. "I've been very impressed." Bernard is set to step into a bigger role with Roman Wilson week-to-week.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught 1-of-2 targets for just ten yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He was targeted just twice and ended with just one catch for ten yards in this win over the Packers. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa held without a catch Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa had close to 100 yards last week, but he did not follow that up with a good performance in Week 5. He wasn't able to catch a single pass on Sunday, despite the fact that Detroit's offense was unstoppable in this win over the Cardinals. He is hard to trust from a fantasy perspective moving forward, as he is likely considered the fifth option on this offense at best.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa hauled in 4-of-8 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa approaches 100 yards on Sunday night
news.impact: TeSlaa had his biggest game of the season so far Sunday night, and has been showing off his big-play ability over the last two games. Over the past two Sundays, the second-year receiver has brought down seven passes for an average of 23.0 yards per catch. TeSlaa has certainly entered the flex conversation as a boom-or-bust option heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Cardinals.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught 3-of-3 targets for 66 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa hauls in three passes in Week 3
news.impact: TeSlaa led the team in receiving yardage despite the limited volume. His three receptions and 66 yards both are season highs for the 24-year-old, and he will look to build on this performance in a road matchup against Carolina.

news.body: Jacob Cowing did not practice on Wednesday due to a hip flexor strain.
news.head: Jacob Cowing (hip) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Cowing continues to battle injuries early in his NFL career. He is competing for a depth role in the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Jacob Cowing impressed with how good of shape he is in.
news.head: Jacob Cowing draws praise from HC Kyle Shanahan
news.impact: Cowing dealt with a hamstring injury early last season and was unable to make an impact when he returned. He'll compete for a depth role in the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.body: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Jacob Cowing (hamstring) is questionable to play in the Divisional Round against the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Jacob Cowing (hamstring) questionable vs. Seattle
news.impact: According to Matt Lively, head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Cowing was "close" to returning to the field. He had his practice window opened earlier this month, but it is not yet clear if he will be ready to return for the Divisional Round, though the 49ers need pass-catching depth.

news.body: The 49ers will open WR Jacob Cowing's practice window this week.
news.head: Jacob Cowing (hamstring) to have practice window opened this week
news.impact: Cowing has yet to appear in a game this season. He could see some snaps in the Wild Card round if Ricky Pearsall remains sidelined.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-5 targsts for 95 yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson hauls in 76 yard pass Sunday
news.impact: Dotson had a 76-yard reception with the Falcons recording 224 total yards of offense as a team. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 1-of-3 targets for only six yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson catches one short pass in Sunday's win
news.impact: Dotson has become a big-play wideout for the Falcons, as he had averaged nearly 28 yards on his seven total grabs over the previous three weeks headed into Sunday's game. He had also found the end zone twice in that stretch. However, as should be expected going forward, Dotson showed in this contest that he is a boom-or-bust fantasy option in the Falcons' passing attack.

news.body: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his five targets for 87 yards and one touchdown in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finds end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Dotson has made the most of his opportunities in the Atlanta passing offense of late, finishing with over 50 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout will look to offer head coach another stable pass-catching option moving forward, with a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finishes with 54 receiving yards in Week 5
news.impact: Dotson made a couple of big grabs in Sunday's game, but he remained no higher than the fourth option in the Falcons' passing attack. Dotson is averaging 18.6 yards per reception and caught his only touchdown so far this season in Week 4. That TD came off the arm of Michael Penix, who is now dealing with a rib injury.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss
news.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught his lone target for 13 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Lane's one target sets a new season low for the rookie. The passing attack was clearly not the same after losing both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Lane and the passing game to struggle if Huntley is unable to play in Week 9.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Lane has logged five targets in two straight games since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect the rookie to continue to get plenty of opportunities in the Ravens' passing attack.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens rookie wide receiver Ja'Kobi Lane caught four passes for 40 yards in Week 6.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane catches four passes in Week 6
news.impact: Lane has been out since Week 1 and was immediately involved in the offense. His receptions, yards and targets were all season highs. Rashod Bateman exited with a shoulder injury, and Lane could have a bigger role if he remains sidelined

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught four of six passes for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers snags four passes in win
news.impact: Meyers led the team in receptions and yards, while coming in second in targets. It was the veteran's second-best yardage total of the season, and he now has 65 yards or more in two of his last three games.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Meyers has been dealing with a pair of injuries lately, but neither of them are serious and he will be good to go for Thursday night's game. He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy option on a week-to-week basis even if active, however.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Meyers is on track to be good to go. He'll remain a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers finishes with a pair of receptions in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers actually led the Jaguars in targets on Sunday, as Trevor Lawrence and backup Quinn Ewers only put the ball in the air a combined 17 times. The Jaguars just did not need to sling it around to vanquish the Colts. Meyers has now caught two or fewer passes in 4-of-7 games so far this season, but he's still a significant piece of a high-powered offense.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker caught six passes for 97 yards while seeing a season-high 13 targets in Week 6.
news.head: Jalen Coker has game-high 97 yards vs. Eagles
news.impact: Coker has at least nine targets in every game he has finished this season, forming an impressive tandem with second-year star Tetairoa McMillan. He had two touchdowns in Week 1 and has not scored since, but Carolina's passing attack has been impressive, and more will come in the future.

news.body: Jalen Coker (quad) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Coker (quad) practices in full again Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Coker was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. He's expected to be close to full health for Sunday's game against the Eagles, in which case fantasy managers can feel comfortable starting him in that matchup.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 4-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jalen Nailor hits pay dirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Nailor found the end zone on a two-yard reception early in the fourth quarter to give the Raiders the lead. This marked his best game of the season, setting a new season-high in receptions and logging his first touchdown of the season. Nailor and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught two of his five targets for 14 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Nailor dismal in Week 7
news.impact: Nailor remains minimally involved in the Las Vegas passing attack, recording less than 30 receiving yards in each of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 1-of-4 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jalen Nailor quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Nailor wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the game and was only able to turn that into nine yards, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returned to practice for the Raiders on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Nailor was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday, and his return is a good sign that he is trending in the right direction. If he's out for another game on Sunday, fantasy managers should expect more work for Tre Tucker against the Bills.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards.
